## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that resolves it.

## Validation

- [ ] `swift test`
- [ ] `swift run yc-onion self-test`
- [ ] `cd streamdeck && npm ci && npm run check`
- [ ] Tested with physical hardware, or clearly marked as protocol-recovered
- [ ] Updated protocol notes and changelog when applicable

## Hardware

List the operating system, Stream Deck version, YC Onion model, advertised
Bluetooth name, and whether the behavior was physically verified.

## Safety

- [ ] No credentials, private logs, Bluetooth addresses, or serial values added
- [ ] Any movement command includes a verified Stop path and targets one device
